I opened every file by format, checked the Office archive CRCs, read the gzip members to EOF and decoded the figures. The saved GEO HTML is a browser challenge. The Elsevier HTML is a redirect. The full papers, supplements, family SOFTs and RNA matrix are readable. The sample sheet and fit provenance account for all 35 nursed P22 hypothalamus RNA GSMs and their matrix columns. Control contributed 10 females and 10 males, MIA 7 females and 8 males. All 73 RNA GSM supplementary fields say NONE. The series CSV has 25,187 data rows of 74 fields each, comprising Symbol and 73 sample columns. TRIM23 lacks 25 of the 35 nursed values. The two assay families have 73 RNA and 24 RRBS BioSample accessions with zero shared. ENA lists 73 experiments and zero analysis records. The registered sex-adjusted limma groupcase coefficient on log2(TPM + 1) tests MIA minus control. Its DE file has 23,701 unique published symbols from 23,702 fitted features, SHA-256 872abbb17399e567cb03650be5f172751dbc43d5aa8e9daced593b65595a3032. The RNA paper reports 18,295 tested genes and 72 piglets. S1 Fig shows nine per cell, while GEO has 7–11 per cell. The PLOS supplements and peer response identify no common within-nursed coefficient. S4 has 11 genes × 12 contrasts. Figure 2C/D and S4 C/E give control minus MIA separately in nursed males/females. For example, Aldh1a1 is −1.05 and +0.41 respectively. Ten of the 11 symbols appear in the registered DE file after case normalization. TTR is absent under that label. Gene Table 2 has six overall MIA - Co rows with proximal-gene Profile entries (five numeric, one NA). The header and footnotes distinguish expression ratios from site-methylation log2 effects and P values. The RNA sample roster, nursing restriction and sex model behind the ratios are unspecified. Live GEO and PLOS checks, the Gene manuscript and an additional OmicsDI accession lookup identified no eligible author coefficient. OmicsDI links back to the same GEO series (https://www.omicsdi.org/dataset/geo/GSE227725). Only the manual and verification ledgers contain this dataset. The proposed audit state, link kinds, partial availability and not_comparable outcome occur in the ledgers. No eligible effect pairs, concordance metrics or verified contrasts follow from these sources. No threshold, sign choice or subset was fitted to seek agreement. All five original computations reproduced independently in refute/audit.py.

The corrected proposal cites the accession-matched family SOFT and series matrix. The companion DOI landing page is also only a redirect.
